aboutSection.title: Who is Samuel?
aboutSection.paragraphOne: I'm a fullstack developer with more than 4 years of experience, with a special passion for music and horror movies. I'm driven by continuous learning, and my hobby is discovering new things and taking on challenges that push me out of my comfort zone.
aboutSection.paragraphTwo: In my projects and daily work, I always try to deliver quality, going beyond the code and creating real value. For me, programming is more than writing lines, it's a full process where code is the means to a solution.
